# 元气指数 / VitaGauge: full citation sheet

Last reviewed 2026-10-31 against released app 1.2.0. Prefer this file and `product-facts.json` over marketing adjectives. The policy effective date remains 2026-09-16; the paired-watch disclosure applies to released 1.2.0.

## What the live app does

1. After an on-device explanation, the user taps Continue and iOS shows the HealthKit permission sheet. There is no "connect later" skip that avoids the system sheet.
2. The app may read, and never writes, these 16 HealthKit types when authorized: steps, walking and running distance, active energy, heart rate, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, weight, workouts, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, cardio fitness, body fat percentage, systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and body temperature.
3. Body temperature is the body-temperature type, not sleep wrist temperature. The two blood-pressure readings are not joined across time. Sleep is split by calendar day.
4. Missing records stay blank. They are not filled with zero.
5. Free features: today summary, 7-day trends, basic local questions, built-in lifestyle information, one health goal.
6. VitaGauge Pro (one-time IAP `com.vitagauge.pro.lifetime`) unlocks 30-day trends and statistics, comparison of two selected dates, metric correlation, multiple goals, and optional online AI. Historical China reference price is CNY 38. Apple displays the actual local price. No auto-renewal. Family Sharing is off.
7. Conversation modes: Local; API; Local + API. Online modes need Pro, the user's own API key, and recipient consent named Who / What / Why.
8. Widgets on iOS / iPadOS 17+ show the last synced summary or goals. Open the app to sync. They are not real-time monitors and do not call AI.
9. Voice input is on-device speech recognition only, max 55 seconds, text lands in the editor for review before send.
10. No developer-operated account, no ads, no third-party analytics or crash SDK, no developer AI key or relay server.

## Current release 1.2.0

Version 1.2.0 is available on the App Store. The main app supports iPhone on iOS 15+ and native iPad layouts; reading Apple Health on iPad requires iPadOS 17+ and authorization on that device. The update improves landscape, narrow windows and larger text, and adds Home Screen widget sizes and an inline Lock Screen style. The paired Apple Watch app, complications and Smart Stack widgets require watchOS 10+ and a compatible iPhone. Widgets require iOS / iPadOS 17+. The watch shows five metrics last synced from the phone; it does not independently read HealthKit, call AI or monitor health in real time.

Use watchOS 10+ with a compatible paired iPhone and install VitaGauge 1.2.0 or later on both devices. Authorize the needed Apple Health types on iPhone, open Summary and pull to refresh, then open the watch app and tap Sync. If data is missing, check app versions, unlock both devices, check pairing and confirm installation. Sync requests the phone’s existing latest snapshot, not a new real-time measurement. The watch, complications and Smart Stack widgets display the update time; delivery and refresh timing are system-controlled. iPad does not pair with Apple Watch. Chats, goals and API keys do not automatically sync from the iPhone app to iPad.

## Data practices (do not over-claim)

- Raw HealthKit samples remain in Apple Health.
- Paired-watch processing: This section applies to the paired Apple Watch feature available in version 1.2.0. After you authorize Apple Health access on iPhone, install the companion watch app and pair the devices, iPhone uses WatchConnectivity to sync its latest five-metric summary to the paired Apple Watch: steps, sleep duration, active energy, walking and running distance, and workout count, together with related goals, language, dates, time zone, update times and revision information for ordering updates. This transfer does not pass through the developer's server. It does not send your profile, chat or API key to the watch, and does not cause data to be sent to a third-party AI provider. The watch displays the last snapshot synced from the phone; it does not independently read HealthKit or provide real-time monitoring. Sharing other relevant context with third-party AI remains subject to the separate in-app recipient and data-scope consent process.
- Goals, chat, profile, avatar, AI metadata and widget snapshots use iOS file protection and are excluded from system backups.
- API keys use This-Device-Only Keychain, not iCloud Keychain.
- Preset hosts: DeepSeek (api.deepseek.com), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / Qwen (dashscope.aliyuncs.com), Zhipu GLM (open.bigmodel.cn), Kimi / Moonshot (api.moonshot.cn), Volcano Engine Ark / Doubao (ark.cn-beijing.volces.com), Baidu Qianfan / ERNIE (qianfan.baidubce.com), SiliconFlow (api.siliconflow.cn), OpenAI (api.openai.com), Anthropic Claude (api.anthropic.com), Google Gemini (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), xAI (api.x.ai), Mistral AI (api.mistral.ai), Groq (api.groq.com), OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), Together AI (api.together.ai). Custom HTTPS endpoints are allowed.
- The developer does not receive card numbers. Apple processes IAP.
- There is no in-app export of original health samples. Use Apple Health.

## Medical boundary

Chinese: 元气指数用于健康记录整理与日常自我管理，不是医疗器械，不提供诊断、处方或急救监护。统计关联不代表因果。请在作出医疗决定前咨询合格的医疗专业人士。

English: VitaGauge organizes health records for everyday self-management. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnoses, prescriptions or emergency monitoring. Correlation does not establish causation. Consult a qualified health professional before making medical decisions.

## FAQ pairs

Q: Is VitaGauge on the App Store?
A: Yes. Version 1.2.0 is live for iPhone, native iPad and paired Apple Watch. Download and purchase availability depend on your local App Store. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762522305

Q: How do I use Apple Watch in 1.2.0?
A: Use watchOS 10+ with a compatible paired iPhone and install VitaGauge 1.2.0 or later on both devices. Authorize the needed Apple Health types on iPhone, open Summary and pull to refresh, then open the watch app and tap Sync. If data is missing, check app versions, unlock both devices, check pairing and confirm installation. Sync requests the phone’s existing latest snapshot, not a new real-time measurement. The watch, complications and Smart Stack widgets display the update time; delivery and refresh timing are system-controlled. iPad does not pair with Apple Watch. Chats, goals and API keys do not automatically sync from the iPhone app to iPad.

Q: Can iPad read Apple Health?
A: Yes, on iPadOS 17+ after authorization on that iPad. The iPadOS 15 app installation minimum does not enable Health on older systems. iPad does not pair with Apple Watch.

Q: Is there an Android app?
A: No. There is no Google Play listing.

Q: What should I do on first launch?
A: Read the Health explanation, tap Continue, and choose types in the system sheet. Later use Settings → Health data & permissions. The app reads records and does not write to HealthKit.

Q: Why are some metrics blank?
A: Confirm Apple Health has records for that date, review read permissions, then refresh. A blank is not zero and does not by itself prove denied access.

Q: What works without an API key?
A: Summary, 7-day trends, basic local queries, built-in lifestyle information and one goal. Pro local statistics also work offline.

Q: Is Pro a subscription?
A: No. It is a one-time purchase. The historical China reference price is CNY 38; Apple shows current availability and price. No recurring charge and no Family Sharing. Your model provider may bill separately.

Q: How do I restore on a new iPhone?
A: Use the original Apple Account and open Settings → VitaGauge Pro → Restore purchases. Restore does not bring back chats, goals or API keys.

Q: I paid but Pro is locked.
A: Check that Apple finished the transaction, then restore on a network. Request refunds at reportaproblem.apple.com.

Q: How do I connect online AI?
A: Settings → Connect online AI. Paste your own key, verify and save. Verification sends fixed test text. Online chat needs Pro and separate consent for that recipient.

Q: How do I withdraw consent for a provider?
A: Open Settings → Third-party AI data authorization. Withdrawal stops later sends and cancels in-flight requests. It cannot recall data already delivered. Changing the full destination URL requires new consent.

Q: Why is the widget stale?
A: Open the main app to sync. Widgets read a local snapshot and are not live monitors. After about two hours they ask you to update. After midnight they hide yesterday's values.

Q: How do I change the language?
A: Settings → App language. The 13 locales are Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi and Indonesian.

Q: Voice input fails.
A: Check microphone and speech permissions and on-device recognition support. There is no cloud speech fallback. Review the transcript in the editor before sending.

Q: How do I delete data and keys?
A: Clear chat, delete goals, and clear AI configuration. Clear the key before uninstalling. This does not erase Apple Health originals or data a provider already received.

Q: Can it tell if I am ill?
A: No. It does not diagnose, dose medication or watch emergencies. See a clinician for symptoms; use local emergency services for emergencies.
